blurb: Members pay a one-time fee and monthly dues for unlimited access to a fleet including tritoons, center consoles, runabouts, deck boats, and surf boats. Membership includes boating safety training and complimentary watersport gear like wakeboards, paddleboards, tubes, and skis. Boats are maintained, fueled, and ready to use at multiple marina locations.
extraNote: $1,500 early termination fee · Members pay up to a $5,000 deductible for boat damage · Reservations should be made 1-2 days in advance, 1 week ahead for holiday weekends · Must stay 100 yards from shorelines and obey restricted zones; $250 fine for violations · At the marina where the boat club is located
